title: observability: token-level cost/latency metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Aisha Kapoor
commits_summary: 6 commits: introduce token-level metrics and tags, expose KV cache hitrate, add Prometheus recording rules and alert changes, create Grafana dashboard JSON and variables, add tests for metric format and dashboard panels, update docs and release notes.
description: Context: Adds token-level cost and latency metrics, improved tracing tags, a dedicated Grafana dashboard, and alert tuning to reduce noise while surfacing regressions. Motivation: postmortems and metric investigations showed token-level cost spikes and missed latency regressions that were not visible in aggregate metrics. This PR introduces consistent metric names and labels, per-token latency histograms with new buckets, KV cache hitrate and prefix cache metrics, and enriches tracing spans with route_id and model_variant for better correlation. It also adds a Grafana dashboard with panels that break down cost and latency by model, route, and customer tier, plus dashboard variables and quick drilldowns to traces. Alert tuning: adjust P95/P99 thresholds, add rate-of-change alerts for token cost, introduce automatic suppression during deployment rollouts and a cooldown window, and wire alerts to the updated runbook links. Related work: ENG-3124, ENG-3179. Checklist: - runtime metrics exporter changes: done - tracing span/tag updates: done - Prometheus recording rules and alerts: done - Grafana dashboard panels and variables: done - tests for metric formats and dashboards: done - docs and release notes: done. Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd123/token-cost-latency. Breaking change: none. Notes: We intentionally kept new histogram buckets backward compatible with existing dashboards; alert thresholds were tuned conservatively and will be revisited after one week of production traffic.
